```go

```

3. Goroutine A accesses freed entry → **panic: concurrent map read/write**

## Corrected Implementation (Key Fixes)

```go
type Cache struct {
    data   map[string]*CacheEntry
    mu     sync.RWMutex  // RWMutex for read-heavy workload
    // ... other fields
}

type Stats struct {
    Hits       atomic.Int64  // Atomic counters
    Misses     atomic.Int64
    LoadErrors atomic.Int64
}

func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{...}
}

func (c *Cache) GetMulti(ctx context.Context, keys []string) map[string]interface{} {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var resultsMu sync.Mutex
    results := make(map[string]interface{})
    
    for _, key := range keys {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(k string) {
            defer wg.Done()
            if value, err := c.Get(ctx, k); err == nil {
                resultsMu.Lock()
                results[k] = value
                resultsMu.Unlock()
            }
        }(key)
    }
    wg.Wait()
    return results
}
```
